description: TINKOU crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2. Reported CIF formula moiety: C104 H83 N8 O17 Sm3,C1 H2 Cl2. From the CIF bond table, Sm1 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm2 (Sm) has 6 O neighbors; Sm3 (Sm) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.988-3.988 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 110.93-117.93°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Sm3(dbm)5(L)2(CH3OH)]·CH2Cl2.
